facts.fact: Biometric Update, relaying We Are Tech Africa, reports that JICA handed Burkina Faso's solidarity and humanitarian-action ministry USD 153,000 of equipment, including 120 fingerprint scanners, in April 2024 for biometric enrolment of IDPs, under a project launched in 2019.

systems.platform: two government-developed applications (fingerprint registration and de-duplication; IDP data processing)
systems.owner: Ministry of Solidarity, Humanitarian Action, National Reconciliation, Gender and Family
